title: Home Ownership Schemes for Malay/Muslim Community
what_it_is: Home Ownership Schemes for Malay/Muslim Community

sections.label: Housing grants and Project DIAN@M³
sections.summary: Government housing grants, priority schemes and HDB guidance support rental flat families, while Project DIAN@M³ connects Malay/Muslim families to national and community programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: On the Government’s part, we have a suite of housing grants and priority schemes to ensure that public housing continues to be affordable and accessible to all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We have also enhanced our measures to provide additional support to families staying in rental flats in recent years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition to generous housing grants, families in public rental can receive one-to-one guidance from the Housing and Development Board's (HDB’s) Home Ownership Support Team (HST) as they work towards buying a flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Project DIAN@M³ aims to provide more effective and integrated support for Malay/Muslim families staying in rental flats by connecting them to the wide range of national and community programmes for education, employment, social support and health.

sections.label: Project DIAN@M³ coordination and employment
sections.summary: Project DIAN@M³ coordinates M³ outreach with ComLink, KidSTART and UPLIFT, and helps rental flat families improve employment and income to buy HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Project DIAN@M³ will see the coordination of M³ outreach efforts with other Government programmes such as the Ministry of Social and Family Development's Community Link or ComLink, Early Childhood Development Agency’s KidSTART and Ministry of Education’s UPLIFT, including facilitating access to pre-school education and ensuring the children can attend school regularly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Second, we want to help families staying in rental flats improve their employment outcomes and earn a stable income, so that they can work towards buying an HDB flat.

sections.label: Back-to-Work Women programme
sections.summary: MENDAKI SENSE's Back-to-Work Women programme connects Malay women who wish to work after marriage or childbirth to employers and job preparation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For Malay women who wish to continue working after marriage or childbirth, the Back-to-Work Women programme by MENDAKI SENSE connects them to potential employers and prepares them to take on new jobs.

sections.label: Project DIAN@M³ resourcing
sections.summary: Project DIAN@M³ will be led by the M³ Engagement Coordination Office and tap on its existing resources.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In terms of resourcing, Project DIAN@M³ will be led by the M³ Engagement Coordination Office (ECO) and tap on its existing resources.
